reservations_status_check.name: reservations_status_check
reservations_status_check.value: ("reservations"."status" = 'confirmed' and "reservations"."cancelled_at" is null) or ("reservations"."status" = 'cancelled' and "reservations"."cancelled_at" is not null)

resource_usage_context_check.name: resource_usage_context_check
resource_usage_context_check.value: ("resource_usage"."session_id" is not null) <> ("resource_usage"."reservation_id" is not null)

resource_usage_interval_check.name: resource_usage_interval_check
resource_usage_interval_check.value: isfinite("resource_usage"."started_at") and ("resource_usage"."ended_at" is null or (isfinite("resource_usage"."ended_at") and "resource_usage"."ended_at" >= "resource_usage"."started_at"))
